statements.__comment: Reset. This job is the only writer of GCPInstance exposure and publicContext. The WHERE matters: an iterative statement stops at the first batch with no updates, so without it only the first LIMIT_SIZE instances were ever reset.
statements.query: MATCH (i:Instance:GCPInstance)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:GCPProject{id: $GCP_PROJECT_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:GCPOrganization{id:$GCP_ORGANIZATION_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID}) WHERE i.exposed_internet IS NOT NULL OR i.exposed_internet_type IS NOT NULL OR i.publicContext IS NOT NULL WITH i LIMIT $LIMIT_SIZE REMOVE i.exposed_internet, i.exposed_internet_type, i.publicContext return COUNT(*) as TotalCompleted

statements.__comment: Connect each INGRESS firewall to the instances it applies to: by target tag, or every instance in the network when it has no target tags and no target service accounts. The network may belong to another project (Shared VPC host); it must be owned by a project of this organization and workspace. Context only (publicContext.firewallRules); exposure is decided below.
statements.query:
MATCH (:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID})-[:OWNER]->(org:GCPOrganization{id:$GCP_ORGANIZATION_ID})-[:OWNER]->(:GCPProject{id: $GCP_PROJECT_ID})-[:RESOURCE]->(inst:GCPInstance)-[:MEMBER_OF_GCP_VPC]->(vpc:GCPVpc)-[:RESOURCE]->(fw:GCPFirewall{direction: 'INGRESS'})
WHERE (org)-[:OWNER]->(:GCPProject)-[:RESOURCE]->(vpc)
AND ((fw)-[:TARGET_TAG]->(:GCPNetworkTag)<-[:TAGGED]-(inst) OR (fw.has_target_service_accounts = false AND NOT (fw)-[:TARGET_TAG]->(:GCPNetworkTag)))
MERGE (fw)-[a:FIREWALL_INGRESS]->(inst)
ON CREATE SET a.firstseen = timestamp()
SET a.lastupdated = $UPDATE_TAG
RETURN count(*) as TotalCompleted

statements.__comment: Delete firewall ingress relationships not refreshed by this run. Anchored on the instance so edges from a host project's firewalls are cleaned too.
statements.query:
MATCH (:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID})-[:OWNER]->(:GCPOrganization{id:$GCP_ORGANIZATION_ID})-[:OWNER]->(:GCPProject{id: $GCP_PROJECT_ID})-[:RESOURCE]->(inst:GCPInstance)<-[a:FIREWALL_INGRESS]-(:GCPFirewall)
WHERE a.lastupdated <> $UPDATE_TAG
DELETE (a)
RETURN count(*) as TotalCompleted

statements.__comment: Per IP family (IPv4: natIP + 0.0.0.0/0; IPv6: ipv6_nat_ip + ::/0; a firewall rule holds one family only): running instance with an external address of that family, in a network owned by a project of this organization and workspace, where an enabled INGRESS allow rule from the any-address range applies to it (target tag it carries, or no target tags and no target service accounts: e.g. default-allow-ssh) for protocol all, or tcp/udp with a port range containing a sensitive port. The allow is cancelled only by one enabled deny rule that applies to the same instance, has priority <= the allow's (GCP: lower number wins, and deny wins a tie), denies the same any-address range, and covers the allow's protocol and whole port range. Partial overlaps, deny rules split across several firewalls and deny rules on target service accounts keep the instance public.
statements.query:
UNWIND [{range: '0.0.0.0/0', v6: false, type: 'unrestricted_access_from_firewall'}, {range: '::/0', v6: true, type: 'unrestricted_ipv6_access_from_firewall'}] AS fam 
MATCH (:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID})-[:OWNER]->(org:GCPOrganization{id:$GCP_ORGANIZATION_ID})-[:OWNER]->(:GCPProject{id: $GCP_PROJECT_ID})-[:RESOURCE]->(i:GCPInstance)-[:MEMBER_OF_GCP_VPC]->(vpc:GCPVpc)-[:RESOURCE]->(fw:GCPFirewall)<-[:ALLOWED_BY]-(rule:GCPIpRule)<-[:MEMBER_OF_IP_RULE]-(:IpRange|Ipv6Range{id: fam.range}) 
WHERE CASE WHEN fam.v6 THEN i.ipv6_nat_ip ELSE i.natIP END IS NOT NULL AND i.status = 'RUNNING' AND fw.direction='INGRESS' AND fw.disabled=FALSE 
AND (org)-[:OWNER]->(:GCPProject)-[:RESOURCE]->(vpc) 
AND ((fw)-[:TARGET_TAG]->(:GCPNetworkTag)<-[:TAGGED]-(i) OR (fw.has_target_service_accounts = FALSE AND NOT (fw)-[:TARGET_TAG]->(:GCPNetworkTag))) 
AND (rule.protocol = 'all' OR (rule.protocol IN ['tcp','udp'] AND any(port IN [80,443,23,3389,25,465,587,3306,5432,1521,1433,135,137,138,139,445,53,20,21,22] WHERE rule.fromport <= port AND port <= rule.toport))) 
AND NOT EXISTS { MATCH (vpc)-[:RESOURCE]->(dfw:GCPFirewall)<-[:DENIED_BY]-(drule:GCPIpRule)<-[:MEMBER_OF_IP_RULE]-(:IpRange|Ipv6Range{id: fam.range}) WHERE dfw.direction = 'INGRESS' AND dfw.disabled = FALSE AND dfw.priority <= fw.priority AND ((dfw)-[:TARGET_TAG]->(:GCPNetworkTag)<-[:TAGGED]-(i) OR (dfw.has_target_service_accounts = FALSE AND NOT (dfw)-[:TARGET_TAG]->(:GCPNetworkTag))) AND (drule.protocol = 'all' OR (drule.protocol = rule.protocol AND drule.fromport <= rule.fromport AND rule.toport <= drule.toport)) } 
WITH DISTINCT i, fam 
SET i.exposed_internet = true, (CASE WHEN NOT fam.type IN coalesce(i.exposed_internet_type, []) THEN i END).exposed_internet_type = coalesce(i.exposed_internet_type, []) + fam.type

statements.__comment: Running instance behind an external load balancer of this project, with or without an external IP: in a target pool of an EXTERNAL / EXTERNAL_MANAGED forwarding rule, or in a managed instance group that is a backend of a backend service that rule reaches (directly or through its URL map). Same resolution as gcp_load_balancer_exposure.json, recomputed here so this job doesn't depend on that job's output. Unmanaged instance group members and backends in other projects are not resolved.
statements.query:
MATCH (:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID})-[:OWNER]->(:GCPOrganization{id:$GCP_ORGANIZATION_ID})-[:OWNER]->(p:GCPProject{id: $GCP_PROJECT_ID})-[:RESOURCE]->(fr:GCPForwardingRule)
WHERE fr.load_balancing_scheme IN ['EXTERNAL', 'EXTERNAL_MANAGED']
OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:RESOURCE]->(um:GCPUrlMap) WHERE um.partial_uri = fr.url_map
WITH p, reduce(acc = [], refs IN collect(coalesce(fr.backend_services, []) + coalesce(um.services, [])) | acc + refs) AS services, reduce(acc = [], refs IN collect(coalesce(fr.target_instances, [])) | acc + refs) AS pool_instances
OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:RESOURCE]->(bs:GCPBackendService) WHERE bs.id IN services
WITH p, pool_instances, reduce(acc = [], groups IN collect(coalesce(bs.backend_groups, [])) | acc + groups) AS groups
MATCH (p)-[:RESOURCE]->(i:GCPInstance)
WHERE i.status = 'RUNNING' AND (i.id IN pool_instances OR EXISTS { MATCH (i)-[:PART_OF]->(mig:GCPInstanceGroup) WHERE mig.instance_group IN groups })
SET i.exposed_internet = true, (CASE WHEN NOT 'external_load_balancer' IN coalesce(i.exposed_internet_type, []) THEN i END).exposed_internet_type = coalesce(i.exposed_internet_type, []) + 'external_load_balancer'

statements.__comment: Generate publicContext for exposed GCP instances, in the same run that set the flags so the two always agree
statements.query: MATCH (:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID})-[:OWNER]->(:GCPOrganization{id:$GCP_ORGANIZATION_ID})-[:OWNER]->(:GCPProject{id: $GCP_PROJECT_ID})-[:RESOURCE]->(n:GCPInstance) WHERE n.exposed_internet = true WITH n, [(n)-[:NETWORK_INTERFACE]->(:GCPNetworkInterface)-[:RESOURCE]->(ac:GCPNicAccessConfig) WHERE ac.public_ip IS NOT NULL | ac.public_ip] AS publicIps, [(n)<-[:FIREWALL_INGRESS]-(fw:GCPFirewall)<-[:ALLOWED_BY]-(allow_rule:GCPIpRule)<-[:MEMBER_OF_IP_RULE]-(src:IpRange|Ipv6Range) WHERE fw.disabled = false AND src.id IN ['0.0.0.0/0', '::/0'] | {firewallId: fw.id, firewallName: fw.name, priority: fw.priority, direction: fw.direction, source: src.id, protocol: allow_rule.protocol, fromPort: allow_rule.fromport, toPort: allow_rule.toport}] AS firewallRules, [(n)-[:TAGGED]->(tag:GCPNetworkTag) | tag.id] AS networkTags SET n.publicContext = apoc.convert.toJson([{resource: n.id, resourceType: 'gcp-compute-instance', context: [{instanceId: n.id, instanceName: n.name, publicIp: coalesce(head(publicIps), n.natIP), publicIpv6: n.ipv6_nat_ip, privateIp: n.networkIP, zone: n.zone_name, machineType: n.machine_type, exposureTypes: n.exposed_internet_type, firewallRules: firewallRules, networkTags: networkTags, status: n.status}]}])
